events.address: The Wang Contemporary, 58 Bowery, New York, NY 10013
events.what_it_is: Zhou Xuerong's first U.S. institutional exhibition, featuring life-size wax sculptures that reframe familiar cultural icons inside scenes of Chinese domestic ritual.
events.what_is_free: The exhibition is free and open to the public. The venue provides a booking path for free reservations.
events.caveats: The Wang Contemporary's official page gives the exhibition run as September 11–27 and lists 12–6 PM. Current public-event listings state it is open Friday through Sunday and free to the public; one secondary listing says 11 AM–6 PM, so this listing uses the official venue's 12–6 PM time.
events.practical_notes: Free reservation booking is available from the official event page. No organizer-approval language is published; treat the reservation as a standard free booking rather than approval-required access.

events.event_name: Rokstar Chicken × Mike's Hot Honey Free Chicken & Fries
events.address: Rokstar Chicken NoHo, 52 E 8th St, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A one-hour student giveaway of chicken and fries from Rokstar Chicken and Mike's Hot Honey.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 eligible students can receive one free chicken-and-fries order.
events.caveats: Students only; bring student ID. First come, first served. Limited to 100 orders and one per customer, so the giveaway can end before the listed end time.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 11 at 3 PM. Arrive early because the offer ends when the 100 available orders are claimed.

events.event_name: Beauty Break with Urban Outfitters & Yes Day
events.address: Urban Outfitters, 1333 Broadway, New York, NY 10018
events.what_it_is: A three-hour beauty activation with an aura photo booth, dirty soda bar, bouquet bar and Yes Day product customization.
events.what_is_free: The aura photo booth, dirty soda bar and bouquet bar are advertised as free while supplies last. Product customization is complimentary only with a Yes Day purchase.
events.caveats: A free Eventbrite RSVP is published for the activation. Current evidence does not show organizer approval; treat this as standard free RSVP. Free activations are while supplies last, and customization requires a Yes Day purchase.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from noon–3 PM at 1333 Broadway. RSVP is recommended through the linked event listing; arrive early for supply-limited activities.
